cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You're cancelling Sunday again? Mum's already made up the spare bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed, same explanation from me. You tell her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the pattern: you cancel, I soften. Now you can arrange the next visit with her too.

mechanism: A diagnoses recurring relationship failure as the sole competent organizer and raises consequences while correcting B.
confusable: Ordinary frustration differs from authoritative correction that classifies each new excuse as the same recurring failure.
comparison: A missed dinner call threatens domestic withdrawal; a family cancellation shifts emotional organizing labor.
seedUse: Use the missed-call and family-visit seeds with practical corrective instructions rather than Stance labels.
